tweaks.title: Set 24-Hour Clock
tweaks.description: Changes clock to display 24-hour format.

tweaks.title: Align Taskbar Left
tweaks.description: Aligns the taskbar to the left side of the screen.

tweaks.title: Block Telemetry via Hosts
tweaks.description: DNS-level block of 100+ Microsoft telemetry domains via hosts file.

tweaks.title: Classic File Explorer Style
tweaks.description: Restores the Windows 10-style File Explorer with the classic ribbon interface and removes the Windows 11 simplified command bar. Power users get full access to all file operations without extra clicks.

tweaks.title: Debloat Windows
tweaks.description: Choose between CoreX Debloat script or Raphire's Win11Debloat script to remove built-in Windows apps and bloatware.

tweaks.title: Detailed BSOD
tweaks.description: Adds detailed information to the Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) screen

tweaks.title: Disable 8.3 Short File Names
tweaks.description: Disables the legacy 8.3 short name generation on NTFS volumes. Reduces filesystem overhead and improves disk performance. Modern applications don't need 8.3 naming.

tweaks.title: Disable Activity History
tweaks.description: Disables Windows Timeline and activity history collection. Prevents Windows from tracking and storing your app activity, browser history, and file access patterns across devices.

tweaks.title: Disable Advertising ID
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows advertising identifier which is used by apps and services to track your activity for personalized ads. Stops targeted advertising across Windows apps and services.

tweaks.title: Disable UI Animations
tweaks.description: Disables all Windows UI animations including window transitions, taskbar animations, and minimization effects. Makes the interface feel instantly responsive. Especially effective on low-end hardware or remote desktop sessions.

tweaks.title: Disable App Access to Tracking Data
tweaks.description: Revokes app access to diagnostics, contacts, calendar, call history, email, tasks, and messaging data. Prevents third-party and Microsoft apps from harvesting your personal data without consent.

tweaks.title: Disable Background MS Store apps
tweaks.description: Disables Microsoft Store apps from running in the background

tweaks.title: Disable Consumer Features
tweaks.description: Prevents Windows from automatically installing games, third-party apps, or app links from the Microsoft Store.

tweaks.title: Disable Copilot
tweaks.description: Removes Microsoft's Copilot feature. (will fail if copilot is not installed)

tweaks.title: Disable Core Isolation
tweaks.description: Disables Core Isolation Memory Integrity to improve system performance

tweaks.title: Disable CPU Core Parking
tweaks.description: Prevents Windows from parking CPU cores, reducing input lag and stutter in games.

tweaks.title: Disable Defender RTP
tweaks.description: Disables Defender Real-time Protection

tweaks.title: Disable Diagnostic Data Collection
tweaks.description: Sets Windows diagnostic data to minimal (security only) level and disables the Diagnostic Policy Service. Stops Windows from collecting crash reports, performance data, and system telemetry beyond basic security info.

tweaks.title: Disable Dynamic Ticking
tweaks.description: Improves system responsiveness and reduces latency by disabling dynamic timer ticks.

tweaks.title: Disable Fast Startup
tweaks.description: Disables Windows Fast Startup to improve system stability

tweaks.title: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations
tweaks.description: Disables Windows fullscreen optimizations (FSE) which can cause stuttering and input lag in games. Forces exclusive fullscreen mode for better gaming performance and lower latency.

tweaks.title: Disable Gamebar
tweaks.description: Disables The Xbox gamebar

tweaks.title: Disable Hibernation
tweaks.description: Disables the hibernation feature to free up disk space and improve shutdown speed

tweaks.title: Disable HPET
tweaks.description: Disables High Precision Event Timer to fix micro-stutter in games.

tweaks.title: Disable IPv6
tweaks.description: Disables IPv6 on all network interfaces. If your ISP doesn't support IPv6 or you experience connectivity issues, disabling it can prevent DNS leaks and improve connection reliability. Most home networks still primarily use IPv4.

tweaks.title: Disable Location Tracking
tweaks.description: Disables Windows location tracking.

tweaks.title: Disable Lock Screen
tweaks.description: Bypasses the Windows lock screen and goes directly to the login screen. Saves a click every time you unlock your PC. Keeps your password security intact — just removes the wallpaper/clock screen before the login prompt.

tweaks.title: Disable Lockscreen Tips
tweaks.description: Disables tips on the lockscreen.

tweaks.title: Disable Memory Compression
tweaks.description: Disables memory compression to free RAM and reduce CPU overhead.

tweaks.title: Disable Mouse Acceleration
tweaks.description: Disables mouse acceleration for a more consistent and precise mouse movement experience. Great for gaming

tweaks.title: Disable Multi-Plane Overlay (MPO)
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows Multi-Plane Overlay which can cause screen flickering, black screens, stuttering, and alt-tab issues with NVIDIA/AMD GPUs. Particularly effective for fixing fullscreen game stability issues.

tweaks.title: Disable Nagle Algorithm (No Delay)
tweaks.description: Disables the Nagle buffering algorithm on all active network adapters. Reduces network latency for real-time applications like online gaming and VoIP by sending packets immediately instead of buffering small ones.

tweaks.title: Disable Nagle's Algorithm
tweaks.description: Disables Nagle's Algorithm to reduce TCP latency for online gaming.

tweaks.title: Disable Network Throttling Index
tweaks.description: Disables Windows network throttling which limits network throughput when multimedia playback is detected. Removes the 10Mbps cap on non-multimedia network traffic. Improves network performance during gaming and streaming.

tweaks.title: Disable NTFS Last Access Timestamp
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from updating the last access timestamp on files and directories. Reduces unnecessary disk writes and improves filesystem performance, especially on HDDs.

tweaks.title: Disable CPU Power Throttling
tweaks.description: Disables Windows power throttling which limits CPU performance for background processes. Ensures maximum CPU performance for gaming and heavy workloads. May increase power consumption and heat on laptops.

tweaks.title: Disable RDP Warnings for Unsigned Files
tweaks.description: Suppresses Windows security warnings when opening unsigned Remote Desktop (.rdp) files.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows Recall
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows Recall feature for better privacy.

tweaks.title: Disable Search Indexing
tweaks.description: Stops SearchIndexer.exe and frees constant disk activity.

tweaks.title: Disable Startup Delay
tweaks.description: Removes startup delay so apps launch immediately on boot.

tweaks.title: Disable SuperFetch / SysMain
tweaks.description: Disables the SysMain (formerly SuperFetch) service which preloads app data into RAM. Frees up memory and reduces disk I/O, especially beneficial for SSDs and systems with limited RAM.

tweaks.title: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.description: Disables the SysMain (formerly Superfetch) service which preloads frequently-used apps into RAM. On SSDs this provides negligible benefit and can cause 100% disk usage spikes. On HDDs it may still be useful. Recommended for systems with SSDs.

tweaks.title: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.description: Disables SysMain service to free 200-500MB RAM and stop constant disk I/O.

tweaks.title: Disable Telemetry
tweaks.description: Disables Windows telemetry and data collection for improved privacy and performance.

tweaks.title: Disable USB Power Savings
tweaks.description: Disables USB selective suspend which powers down USB devices to save energy. Prevents USB device disconnects, mouse/keyboard lag, and audio dropouts. Critical for competitive gaming and audio production.

tweaks.title: Disable Visual Effects
tweaks.description: Sets Windows to Best Performance mode, disabling all visual candy.

tweaks.title: Disable Wifi Sense
tweaks.description: Disables Wifi Sense to prevent sharing of Wi-Fi networks with contacts

tweaks.title: Disable Window Animations
tweaks.description: Disables minimize/maximize animations to make the entire OS feel instant.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows Search Indexing
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows Search indexer service (WSearch) which constantly indexes files in the background. Saves significant CPU, disk I/O, and memory. Use if you search files rarely or use third-party search tools.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows Tips & Suggestions
tweaks.description: Disables Windows tips, tricks, and suggestions that appear in notifications, Start menu, and Settings. Also disables Microsoft's 'Get started' and 'Tips' apps. Reduces visual clutter and unwanted notifications.

tweaks.title: Enable Detailed Crash Dumps
tweaks.description: Configures Windows to generate complete memory dumps instead of minidumps on crashes. Provides much more diagnostic data for troubleshooting blue screens and system freezes. Useful for advanced users debugging driver or hardware issues.

tweaks.title: Enable Dark Mode
tweaks.description: Enables dark mode for Windows. Great for unactivated systems.

tweaks.title: Enable End Task With Right Click
tweaks.description: Enables the "End Task" option in the taskbar context menu

tweaks.title: Enable Game Mode
tweaks.description: Enables Game Mode on windows

tweaks.title: Enable HAGS
tweaks.description: Enables HAGS (Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling)

tweaks.title: Enable MSI Mode for GPU
tweaks.description: Switches GPU to Message-Signaled Interrupts for lower latency and better FPS stability.

tweaks.title: Enable Optimization For Windowed Games
tweaks.description: Enables Optimization For Windowed Games on windows

tweaks.title: Hide Taskview and Widgets
tweaks.description: Hides the Taskview and Widgets buttons on the taskbar.

tweaks.title: Menu Show Delay Zero
tweaks.description: Removes the delay when opening menus.

tweaks.title: Optimize Network Settings
tweaks.description: Changes various Windows settings to improve network latency and speeds.

tweaks.title: Optimize Nvidia Settings
tweaks.description: Changes Nvidia Control Panel settings to improve gaming performance

tweaks.title: Optimize SSD TRIM & Defrag Schedule
tweaks.description: Disables automatic defragmentation (unnecessary for SSDs), ensures TRIM is enabled, and optimizes the Storage Tiers optimization schedule. Prevents Windows from unnecessary defrag operations on SSDs that reduce their lifespan.

tweaks.title: Remove Clipchamp
tweaks.description: Removes the Clipchamp video editor that comes pre-installed with Windows 11. Most users don't need it and it runs background processes. Can be reinstalled from the Store if needed.

tweaks.title: Remove Cortana
tweaks.description: Removes the Cortana app and disables its background processes. Cortana is no longer needed in Windows 11 and wastes system resources running in the background.

tweaks.title: Remove Gaming Apps
tweaks.description: Removes Xbox app, Xbox Game Bar, and Xbox Game Overlay

tweaks.title: Remove Microsoft Bing Integration
tweaks.description: Removes Bing apps and disables Bing web search in Windows Search.

tweaks.title: Remove OneDrive
tweaks.description: Removes OneDrive from the system

tweaks.title: Remove Microsoft Teams (Consumer)
tweaks.description: Removes the consumer version of Microsoft Teams that ships with Windows 11 and auto-starts in the background. Frees system resources. The enterprise Teams app (if installed separately) is not affected.

tweaks.title: Revert Context Menu
tweaks.description: Reverts the context menu to the default Windows 10 context menu.

tweaks.title: Set High Performance Power Plan
tweaks.description: Activates the Ultimate Performance or High Performance power plan.

tweaks.title: Set PowerShell 7 as Default
tweaks.description: Sets PowerShell 7 as the default profile in Windows Terminal (installs PS7 if missing)

tweaks.title: Set Services to Manual
tweaks.description: Sets various Windows services to Manual startup type to improve performance.

tweaks.title: Set Time To UTC
tweaks.description: Sets the system time to UTC, Great for dual booting

tweaks.title: Set Win32 Priority Separation
tweaks.description: Optimizes foreground app performance by modifying system process priority behavior.

tweaks.title: Show File Extensions
tweaks.description: Shows file extensions and hidden files in Explorer.

tweaks.title: Show Seconds in Taskbar Clock
tweaks.description: Enables the seconds next to the clock in the taskbar

tweaks.title: Ultimate Performance Power Plan
tweaks.description: Enables And Applies The Windows Ultimate Powerplan for better performance

tweaks.title: Disable Windows Platform Binary Table
tweaks.description: Prevents your computer vendor from executing programs at boot, reducing potential security risks.
